page.notes: The "Elisca" at the lower right is a catchword and is given as the catchword element. Marginal "De Ieiunio." is printed in the left margin. Right edge fragments belong to the adjoining page and are omitted. No page number is printed. Printed "Pharao?" and "inquam?" carry their question marks as punctuation. The text is set in italic throughout; no Greek or Hebrew appears on this page. Printed ampersand signs are given as "&" in the XML.
